people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
translations.bsb: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
translations.asv: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers' houses.
